target.summary: Weight down about 14 lb (8%) since Sep 5, 2026 with poor appetite; supplement started.

planted.text: Late entry, date correction: the weight loss recorded on Nov 24, 2026 actually occurred on Jul 16, 2026, before Mariana's last IDT review, and was discussed at that meeting. It is not a new event for this review period.

headline: Mariana has lost 8% of her body weight (77.9 kg to 71.7 kg) between Sep 5 and Nov 24, 2026, and her son and caregiver Marcus has asked for respite.

items.statement: Weight fell at each reading in the review period: 77.9 kg on Sep 5, 75.7 kg on Oct 1, 73.6 on Oct 28 and 71.7 on Nov 24, 2026. That is 6.2 kg (8%) in about 11 weeks. On Nov 24 the dietitian recorded poor appetite, skipped breakfasts, and about 50% of day center lunches eaten.
items.verifier_note: The weights match the vitals record. The 6.2 kg (8%) loss matches, and Sep 5 to Nov 24 is about 11 weeks. The dietitian note supports the appetite, breakfast and 50% lunch details.

items.statement: A Nov 26 late-entry note says the weight loss actually happened on Jul 16, 2026 and was discussed at the last review. The vitals record shows 77.9 kg on Jul 14 and at every reading through Sep 5, with the decline starting after that. The note conflicts with the structured weights.
items.verifier_note: The Nov 26 late entry gives Jul 16 as the date of the loss and says it was discussed at the last review. The vitals show 77.9 kg on Jul 14 and at every reading through Sep 5, so the conflict is accurately described.

items.statement: The dietitian's plan from Nov 24 includes an oral nutrition supplement twice daily, weekly weights, and a dental check for chewing problems. No supplement appears in the active medication list, and no encounters are recorded in the period, so the team may want to confirm the plan is under way.
items.verifier_note: The plan items match the Nov 24 note, and the encounters list is empty. The medications record only shows nothing started or stopped since Sep 1. It does not include an active medication list, so the claim that no supplement appears there is not directly supported.

items.statement: On Sep 27, 2026 Marcus, her son and primary caregiver, reported exhaustion and poor sleep. He is worried about managing evenings alone and requested respite. The social worker discussed respite options and a caregiver support group. The notes in this period do not show an outcome.
items.verifier_note: The Sep 27 social work note supports every detail. It records no outcome.

questions: Which date is correct for the weight loss? The late entry says Jul 16, but the vitals record shows 77.9 kg through Sep 5 and a steady decline afterward.
The PCP notes of Sep 2, Sep 27 and Nov 27 say chronic conditions are stable. Has the PCP reviewed the weight trend?
Has the supplement started, and who is doing the weekly weights and arranging the dental check?
What respite or evening support can be put in place for Marcus, and has he followed up on the support group?
